verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents its own no-code Agent Builder, which lets users prototype and deploy voice agents in the browser without writing code, so the core no-code building element is present. Nothing in the evidence shows that it supports multi-step flow design, branching, state management or agent handoffs. missing for 10: evidence of a visual flow canvas, branching logic, conversation states, agent-to-agent handoffs, in-depth builder docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can design multi-step conversation flows in a visual builder with branching, states, and handoffs without writing code

citations.quote: LiveKit Agent Builder to prototype and deploy agents directly in your browser without writing code
LiveKit Agent Builder: Prototype and deploy voice agents directly in your browser, without writing any code.
